name: trustreceivable
description: Trust infrastructure for MSME receivables — verification, blockchain proof, AI risk intelligence, and Receivable Passport.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix blockchain
scripts.dev: concurrently -n chain,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run blockchain" "npm run wait:chain && npm run deploy:contract && npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix blockchain && npm run test --prefix backend
